## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For UI changes, include relevant platform checks and screenshots when useful.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression tests where behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and campaign references are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials or private player data are included.
- [ ] Any new third-party assets have redistribution terms and attribution recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
